---
title: Explore standalone plotting
---

The gallery has **72 scientific configurations and 216 interface views** across nine families,
two modes, two profiles and two surfaces, shown with Python/Matplotlib,
R/ggplot2 and base R. They are reviewed static exports; no plotting engine runs
in this website. JavaScript has a [separate interactive example](plotting-javascript.qmd);
it is not part of these 216 static views. [Installation and scientific choices](plotting-packages.md).

```{=html}
<section id="plotting-gallery" aria-label="Plotfoundry gallery" aria-busy="true">
<div class="plot-controls">
<label>Interface<select id="plot-interface"></select></label>
<label>Family<select id="plot-theme"></select></label>
<label>Mode<select id="plot-mode"></select></label>
<label>Profile<select id="plot-profile"></select></label>
<label>Surface<select id="plot-surface"></select></label>
<label>Preview size<select id="plot-size"></select></label>
</div>
<p id="plot-status" role="status">Loading reviewed gallery…</p>
<figure hidden><div class="plot-image-wrap" tabindex="0" aria-label="Plot preview; scroll horizontally at intended width"><img id="plot-preview" alt=""></div><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
<p id="plot-metadata"></p>
<p id="plot-vector-policy"></p>
<nav id="plot-downloads" aria-label="Selected specimen downloads"></nav>
<p>With the appropriate independent package installed, reproduce this selection:</p>
<pre id="plot-reproduce" aria-label="Reproduction command"></pre>
</section>
<script type="module" src="assets/plotting-gallery.mjs"></script>
```

**Profile** selects reading or presentation text and mark sizes. **Surface**
selects a paper or panel background.

## View and download without JavaScript

[Open the complete static download index](_generated/plotting/index.html).
Every view has its PNG, sanitized report and runnable gallery source. Python
vectors are available for every case; the larger R vector collection is represented
by one configuration per family, for **both native R routes**. The selector shows
exact availability, never an unexplained disabled download.

Python canvases are 8 × 8 inches; R canvases are 8 × 9. Comparing them does not
claim pixel-identical native marker geometry or device quantization. Fit previews
change apparent text size. Use **intended** width (640 reading / 1152 presentation
CSS pixels) to inspect the declared placement. Narrow screens scroll without
cropping or inverting the image. [Python details](plotting-python.qmd) and
[R details](plotting-r.qmd).
